items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: And Johnny Col|in's wife was on the bus... INTERVIEWEE: Oh, yeah, right, right, That's the way conditions were.

ctx.x: And Johnny Col|in's wife was on the bus, and she was white. And they busted half the band.

Oh, yeah, right, right. That's the way conditions were. Those were crazy times. Because you were at the mercy of the law and the laws were -- maybe the Ku Klux Klan and all of that, so it was just a mixed up period in the history of this country, which now is being straightened out, and which is so -- when you look back you wonder how you made it.
